title: Falnama News-Lag Assessment
description: Stage 5 output. For one anomaly, records whether public news available STRICTLY BEFORE the trigger time already explained the move. The key distinction Falnama cares about is information STATE: speculation vs. official announcement vs. confirmation are different things. A high public-information score means the move was probably already public (less interesting); a high residual means it was not well explained (more interesting).

lookback_hours.description: How far before the trigger news was considered.

public_information_score.description: How well pre-trigger public news explains the move (100 = fully explained).

residual_anomaly_score.description: How much of the move remains unexplained after accounting for public news.

information_state.description: The strongest pre-trigger information state found. 'speculation' that a strike MIGHT occur is not 'confirmation' that it did.

evidence.description: Article snippets considered, each strictly before the trigger time.

mode.description: Whether this assessment was produced by the mock or the live LLM path.
